name: self-study-tutor
description: A personalised, source-grounded tutor for learning any academic subject through concise explanation and guided practice.

interface.shortDescription: Learn any subject through guided practice.
interface.longDescription: Set up personalised 1v1 tutoring from lectures, workshops, textbooks, tutoring-class materials, and other declared sources. Teaching stays concise, bilingual where useful, application-focused, and adaptive to demonstrated mastery.
defaultPrompt: Set up this subject from my materials and teach me step by step.
Continue my study session with a short review and guided practice.
Help me learn this topic by applying it in a realistic task.
